attribution-method-amendment-v2.change: Run the intrusive allocator tracing in two additional full-scale processes, one at c1 and one at c32, with 15-second measurement/5-second warmup and a 5-second BPF window. The six original 40-second CPU/stage attribution runs do not enable BPF.
attribution-method-amendment-v2.reason: Avoid charging intrusive allocator probe overhead to the component stage census. No results existed for either diagnostic family when this amendment was frozen.

attribution-method-amendment-v3.change: Identify the measured process only after two setup shutdown censuses AND the third startup-ready census. Wait 15 seconds after readiness before the 20-second CPU sample, or 8 seconds before the separate 5-second allocator trace.
attribution-method-amendment-v3.reason: The full comparison shows about 13 seconds of third-process startup; waiting from process creation would capture recovery. These markers exclude startup; the margins exclude the five-second warmup. No diagnostic results had started.

attribution-method-amendment-v4.change: Use the software cpu-clock:u event at 997 Hz instead of hardware cycles:u, retaining DWARF stack capture and both self/inclusive reports.
attribution-method-amendment-v4.reason: Read-only preflight found no cpu PMU in sysfs; exposed event sources are breakpoint, kprobe, msr, software, tracepoint and uprobe. Hardware cycles are unavailable on this VM. No diagnostic capture had started.
attribution-method-amendment-v4.unit: sampled user CPU time, not hardware cycles

attribution-method-amendment.change: Append a separate intrusive 5-second BPF allocator-entry window after each 20-second perf capture. Count malloc/calloc/realloc/mallocx/rallocx/sdallocx entries and requested-size arguments, plus provenance constructor entries. Do not sum nested APIs or infer successful allocation bytes. No comparison window is traced.
attribution-method-amendment.reason: Measure allocator traffic directly in addition to CPU attribution; no source/runtime edits.
attribution-method-amendment.workload_scope_correction: Ticketdesk registers a cold-board projection. The selected write/read/interactive load profiles do not query it; no tokenized text or row policy. This corrects method prose, not the workload.

retention.qualifying_improvement: candidate median throughput exceeds control by more than 4 percent on at least one of write_only c1/c32
retention.regression_refusal: candidate loses more than 4 percent relative to control in any measured cell
retention.banked_relationship: publish every cell against bank; no sub-4-percent bank improvement claim
retention.correctness: all cells clean; any execution/eligibility failure retained, never result-selected retry

candidate_attribution_if_qualified.purpose: diagnostic confirmation of the removed constant computation; not a new performance gate

method-v1-build-refusal.failure_policy: Retain every attempt and error; do not retry based on performance. Refuse to infer missing component measurements or count nested stage timings twice.
method-v1-build-refusal.workload_scope: Ticketdesk without projections, tokenized text, or row policy; measurements do not qualify N1/E2 release gates.

method.failure_policy: Retain every attempt and error; do not retry based on performance. Refuse to infer missing component measurements or count nested stage timings twice.
method.workload_scope: Ticketdesk without projections, tokenized text, or row policy; measurements do not qualify N1/E2 release gates.
method.pre_measurement_amendment: The first locked current runner build refused the stale nested CRC lock. Synchronize only that lock with the accepted workspace graph; no workload measurements had started.

qualification.gate: predeclared throughput criterion; all latency observations retained in raw receipts

metadata.workload_scope: Ticketdesk named-query reads and writes; harness registers a cold board projection but selected loads neither activate nor query it; no text index or row policy. The amended scope supersedes the original plan wording.

reduction.reports: Allowlisted fields from all 76 completed raw reports, whose SHA-256 hashes are retained. No result-selected performance retry.
reduction.cpu: Exclusive user CPU self symbols grouped by named owner, not inclusive semantic ownership. Period totals equal the complete perf report event count. No unresolved work is assigned to an owner.
reduction.census: Only final measured-process terminal census, after two setup terminal censuses. Total nanoseconds divided by committed commands or service invocations, including warmup. Parent/child stages overlap.
reduction.allocator: API entry counts and requested-size arguments in separate intrusive five-second traces; calls can nest and byte arguments are not successful allocation or resident bytes.
reduction.privacy: Raw logs, PIDs, addresses, machine names and local paths are excluded. Numeric aggregates are retained with source hashes; raw captures require access to the private campaign archive.
